Code; sha256 is of the canonical body. MAJOR 2026 RESTRUCTURING under Act 110: (1) two brackets replace three: 1.99% of taxable income under $30,000, and (5.21% x taxable income) - $966 at $30,000 or more (equivalent to marginal 1.99%/5.21%); same schedule for all filing statuses; (2) South Carolina NO LONGER starts from federal taxable income: for tax years after 2025 it starts from federal AGI and does not allow the federal standard deduction, itemized deductions, OBBBA senior/tips/overtime/car-loan deductions or QBI deduction; (3) new SC Income Adjusted Deduction (SCIAD), encoded here as standardDeduction at its MAXIMUM: $15,000 single or MFS, $22,500 HoH, $30,000 MFJ/surviving spouse. SCIAD phase-out by federal AGI: single/MFS full to $40,000, reduced by the fraction (AGI - 40,000)/55,000, zero at $95,000 or more; HoH full to $60,000, reduced by (AGI - 60,000)/82,500, zero at $142,500 or more; MFJ full to $80,000, reduced by (AGI - 80,000)/110,000, zero at $190,000 or more (reduction rounded down to a multiple of $10). Retirement/age deductions (12-6-1170, unchanged by Act 110): retirement income deduction up to $3,000 per person under 65 and up to $10,000 from the year the taxpayer turns 65; plus an age-65+ deduction of $15,000 per person against any income, REDUCED by the retirement deduction claimed (so the total for a 65+ taxpayer is $15,000, not $25,000). Encoding: seniorExtraDeduction 15,000 (65+) and retirementIncomeExclusion 3,000 at any age; an engine that stacks both overstates the 65+ deduction by up to $3,000 per person. Military retirement is fully deductible. Social Security is fully exempt. 44% of net capital gain (held more than one year) is deductible. Dependent exemption (inflation-indexed, about $4,930; doubled for children under 6) is not modelled. Brackets are indexed annually by Chained CPI. From 2027 the 5.21% top rate falls automatically when the Board of Economic Advisors projects income tax revenue growth of at least 5%, until it reaches 1.99%, then continues toward 0%. SC earned income credit capped at $200. No local income taxes.

flags.standardDeduction: simplified: SCIAD maximum; phases out linearly with federal AGI to zero at $95,000 (single/MFS), $142,500 (HoH), $190,000 (MFJ) - see notes
flags.seniorExtraDeduction: simplified: $15,000 age-65+ deduction is reduced by any retirement income deduction claimed
flags.retirementIncomeExclusion: simplified: $3,000 under 65; $10,000 from age 65 but that amount counts against the $15,000 age-65+ deduction (seniorExtraDeduction), so only the under-65 amount is encoded
